title.en: Infectious Diseases (Prescribed Entities and Institutions) Regulations 2008

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en:
1. These Regulations may be cited as the Infectious Diseases (Prescribed Entities and Institutions) Regulations 2008 and shall come into operation on 10th June 2008.
[S 938/2024 wef 06/12/2024]

2. For the purposes of section 4(1)(c) of the Act, the prescribed entities or institutions, any employee of which may be appointed a Health Officer for the purposes of the Act or any provision of the Act, are specified in the Schedule.
[S 938/2024 wef 06/12/2024]
